SHARED_BASTION.EmptyGroup: No facilities in this section yet.
SHARED_BASTION.BuildHint: The owner character pays the cost. Construction starts when confirmed.
SHARED_BASTION.RequirementsHint: One condition per line: tool:smith for tool proficiency, weapon:mar for weapon proficiency, item:identifier for an owned item, spellcasting for a spellcasting class. approval:identifier requires a reasoned GM approval. Add any template prerequisites not modeled by the system here.
SHARED_BASTION.ExceptionHint: Provide a reason for each exception. Empty fields grant no exception. Ownership and costs still apply.
SHARED_BASTION.NoTemplates: No accessible facility templates found. The GM can grant read access to existing world items or appropriate compendiums. Players must not be able to edit their rule definitions.
SHARED_BASTION.RemoveHint: This facility will be removed. Active orders end; previously paid costs are not refunded.
SHARED_BASTION.TemplateRulesHint: Define prerequisites and rule values for new facilities from this template. The definition stays in this world; the original item or compendium is unchanged. Existing facilities keep their current rules.
SHARED_BASTION.Repeatable: Repeatable when permitted by the facility description
SHARED_BASTION.OrderCostHint: Cost and duration are calculated from the selected action and template.
SHARED_BASTION.CancelOrderHint: The current order will end. Previously paid costs are not refunded.
SHARED_BASTION.OccupantsHint: Drag NPCs from the actor directory or an accessible compendium into the slots. Empty slots remain unoccupied.
SHARED_BASTION.CalendarTurnHint: Elapsed calendar days are processed once. This turn adds no extra days and repairs shut-down facilities according to the system rules.
SHARED_BASTION.ManualTurnHint: This turn advances all assigned facilities by the configured duration
SHARED_BASTION.TransferDiscardHint: Pending copies will be removed. Originals remain on their characters and backups remain in the private GM journal.
SHARED_BASTION.TransferHint: Selected facilities, including ongoing orders and occupants, become public in the shared bastion. Full backups in the private GM journal and inactive copies are created first. Originals are removed only after verification. Do not edit the sources during transfer. External macros or links outside the transferred facilities are not changed automatically.
SHARED_BASTION.TransferEmpty: No additional facilities on participant characters.
